title: 第三章 居然还是个大作家
slug: 不正经的异世界攻略手册
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

说什么自己是萝O控当然是逗她的啦，

亚枫再次收留这位王女的真正目的很简单，除了上一世的个人情感外，更多的就是她背后的情报和资源，未来有很多重要的资源，都需要依靠她才能得到。

而这一次，亚枫的目标很名确，利用上一世的情报和信息差，独自升级，独自成就最强英雄王，然后用自己的方式，达成自己真正想要的完美结局。

虽然面前这个人堪称是诡异的程度，但伊尔莎已经没有别的选择了。

至少，跟着他能得到暂时的庇护，为自己的将来做打算。

即使完全搞不明白他想要做什么，伊尔莎还是跟随着他，离开了她生活了十八年的魔族领土，萨维顿。

在登上天空船之前，亚枫给了她一张身份卡，上面是一个全新的名字。

“琳达·哈曼。”

“这是你的新身份，已经在王国户籍系统里注册过了，我也查过，用这个名字的女性全世界有七百多万人，相当大众化，足够隐蔽了，回头也能用这个身份给你注册一个幻网通。”亚枫说道。

“这...所以，你是提前很久就在做准备了？”伊尔莎看着身份证问道。

“嗯哼。”

伊尔莎有些奇怪，皇室内部的争斗虽然激烈，但一直都是不对外的，她的落败也是突然性的，就连她都措不及防，但这个男人是怎么能够提前得知并连她新身份都准备好了的？

但她也没有多问，老老实实的跟随亚枫，登上了空天船，她的身份核实也没有任何问题，这让她暗自松了一口气。

乘坐着空天船，经过两天三夜的旅途，她来到了人类王国的首都，英白格尔王城。

那是不输于魔族王城的繁荣城市，于空天船上一眼望去尽是高低错落的建筑群，耸立于大地之上，

在停战的这些年，费因也同样在养精蓄锐，加速自身发展啊...

伊尔莎心中想到。

空天船停下，她跟随亚枫走出了机场，进入了王城。

作为落难的王女来到敌国的首都，她的内心忐忑不安，虽然戴着兜帽，但还是害怕被人认出来。

在她担心的时候，亚枫却带着她一路离开了王城，来到了偏僻的郊区，到了一栋三层的陈旧小庄园前。

“你，你带我来这里做什么？”

伊尔莎顿时感觉一阵不安，周围这么偏僻，人烟稀少，又是这种古旧的小屋，

在这种地方，不管他对自己做出什么都不会有人发现。

专门选在这里作为囚禁并娱乐她的场所吗...

“这里是我的家，”亚枫说道。

“你家？你为什么住这么破的地方？”

伊尔莎震惊道，以亚枫的魔法水平，随随便便都能在王国或者教会里得到最顶尖的职位，王城最核心段带花园泳池的大豪斯随便他挑的，但结果却住在这种穷乡僻壤里一个像废弃几百年简单翻修的陈旧小屋里？

“你还真是何不食肉糜啊公主殿下，知道现在王城房价多少一平吗？一个厕所都够买下十几栋这样的屋子了，”亚枫说道。

“你....很缺钱？”

她看到了院子里还种着蔬菜，甚至还有一个鸡窝，几只大母鸡带着几只小鸡正散着步。

伊尔莎不太理解一个大魔法师是怎么混成这样的，明明只要成为了术师，哪怕只是最低等级的补贴都能成为中产家庭，住上王城的高级公寓。

，客厅沙发前铺着柔软的地毯，壁炉前堆放着果木，窗台上摆放着绿植鲜花，墙上也挂着颇具艺术感的挂画。

客厅里还有着一台最新型号的晶石放映机，算是这里最值钱的家具了。

屋内带着点温馨的生活气息，一看主人家就在装修上花了不少心思。

Of course he was teasing her by saying that he was a lolita.

Yafeng's real purpose of taking in the princess again is very simple. In addition to the personal emotions in the previous life, it is also the intelligence and resources behind her. In the future, there will be many important resources that need to be obtained by relying on her.

But this time, Yafeng's goal is very clear. He uses the intelligence and information gap in his previous life to upgrade alone, become the strongest hero king alone, and then use his own way to achieve the perfect ending he really wants.

Although the person in front of her could be described as weird, Ilsa had no other choice.

At least, you can get temporary shelter by following him and make plans for your future.

Even though she had no idea what he wanted to do, Ilsa still followed him and left Saviton, the demon territory where she had lived for eighteen years.

Before boarding the skyship, Yafeng gave her an identity card with a brand new name on it.

"Linda Harman."

"This is your new identity. It has been registered in the Kingdom's household registration system. I have also checked that there are more than 7 million women with this name around the world. It is quite popular and hidden enough. I can use this identity to register you for a fantasy network later." Yafeng said.

"This...so, you have been preparing for it long in advance?" Ilsa asked, looking at the ID card.

"Uh-huh."

Ilsa was a little strange. Although the battle within the royal family was fierce, it was always kept secret from the public. Her defeat was also sudden. Even she was caught off guard. But how could this man know about her new identity in advance and prepare it?

But she didn't ask any more questions. She followed Ya Feng and boarded the spaceship honestly. There were no problems with her identity verification, which made her secretly relieved.

Taking the spaceship, after two days and three nights of journey, she arrived at the capital of the human kingdom, King Yinbagel.

It was a prosperous city that was not inferior to the Demon Clan's royal city. From the skyship, all you could see were scattered buildings of high and low heights, towering above the earth.

During the years of the armistice, Fein was also recuperating his energy and accelerating his own development...

Ilsa thought to herself.

The skyship stopped, and she followed Yafeng out of the airport and entered the royal city.

As a princess in distress, she came to the capital of an enemy country. She felt uneasy inside. Although she was wearing a hood, she was still afraid of being recognized.

When she was worried, Yafeng took her all the way out of the royal city, to a remote suburb, and to a three-story old manor.

"You, what did you bring me here for?"

Ilsa suddenly felt uneasy. The surrounding area was so remote, sparsely populated, and it was such an old cabin.

In a place like this, no matter what he does to himself, no one will find out.

Was this specially chosen as a place to imprison and entertain her...

"This is my home," Yafeng said.

"Your home? Why do you live in such a shabby place?"

Ilsa was shocked and said that with Yafeng's magic level, he could easily get the top position in the kingdom or the church. He could choose a large house with a garden and swimming pool in the core of the royal city, but he ended up living in an old hut that looked like it had been abandoned for hundreds of years and was simply renovated in such a remote place?

"Why don't you eat minced meat? Your Royal Highness, do you know how much the house price in the royal city is now? One toilet is enough to buy a dozen such houses," Yafeng said.

"You... are short of money?"

She saw vegetables growing in the yard and even a chicken coop, with several big hens taking a few chicks for a walk.

Ilsa didn't quite understand how a great magician could become like this. It was clear that as long as he became a magician, he could become a middle-class family and live in a high-end apartment in the royal city, even with the lowest level of subsidies.

, there is a soft carpet in front of the sofa in the living room, fruit trees are stacked in front of the fireplace, green plants and flowers are placed on the windowsill, and artistic paintings are hung on the walls.

There is also a latest model crystal projector in the living room, which is the most valuable piece of furniture here.

The house has a warm atmosphere of life, and the owner has put a lot of thought into the decoration.
